scope: Full terminal scrollback clipboard and file export actions

contracts.behavior: The shared right-click and Edit Copy section orders Copy, Copy as HTML, Copy All Scrollback, Copy All Scrollback as HTML, Save All Scrollback and Save All Scrollback as HTML consecutively; the full-scrollback actions have visible copy/save icons even with GTK menu images disabled and remain enabled without a selection
Copy All Scrollback copies plain text from the visible screen and retained offscreen history, including Unicode, without sending any input to the child

Copy All Scrollback as HTML offers HTML source via text targets and a UTF-16 text/html payload for rich-text destinations, preserving bold, colour, Unicode and escaped markup across the full retained buffer without sending input to the child

The actual save menu actions open overwrite-confirming file choosers with .txt/.html defaults and export visible plus offscreen content as UTF-8 text or a standalone HTML document retaining colour, bold and escaped markup; exports leave the clipboard, child PTY and scroll position unchanged
Cancelling either dialog creates no export and does not overwrite an existing file; write errors reach the caller rather than disappearing
Empty buffers produce valid exports and discarded history is not resurrected; the HTML range includes the last retained content even when the oldest retained row is no longer zero

environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG, Xvfb and session bus; real GTK menu actions, VTE buffer, PTY and clipboard targets
environments.native_wayland: Cross-application Wayland clipboard transfer is not covered by the Xvfb checks
